title: Grain Boundary Solute Segregation and Excess Volume Analysis Using pyiron-workflow
description: An atomistic workflow for investigating solute segregation at a Σ5 (120)[001] tilt grain boundary in aluminium. The workflow relaxes bulk and grain-boundary structures, identifies symmetrically distinct atomic sites, substitutes Cu, Ag, Au and Ni solutes at different sites, and calculates their segregation energies. It also evaluates atomic Voronoi volumes and correlates site excess volumes with segregation energies using an EMT interatomic potential.
steps: Identification of symmetrically distinct atomic sites
